levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
جعفر بن محمد بن عبد الله

notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» is replaced by the six inherited links of prev1 (report 2), which writes its chain; no back_reference is written for it
The Imam is written «أبي عبد الله أو أبي جعفر»: both are written, read as alternatives in one level; the text does not say which (rule 9)
«فخفنا عليه، فقلنا له» is the narrators' own account; the Imam answers («قال: بل ائذنوا له»), so he is a link in his own place
